items.title: Raja Ravi Varma Gallery of Oleographs and Chromo Lithographs inaugurated in Chennai
items.text: Chennai hosts the inauguration of Raja Ravi Varma Gallery of Oleographs and Chromo Lithographs at CPRAF, marking 60 years of cultural philanthropy.

items.title: Chennai International Book Fair 2027 to be held from January 16 to 18
items.text: Chennai International Book Fair 2027 runs Jan 16–18 at Chennai Trade Centre, featuring global publishers, authors, translators, and a literary agent training program.

items.title: India’s building automation market likely to grow to $12.56 billion by 2030
items.text: India’s building automation market is projected to expand from $4.32 billion in 2025 to $12.56 billion by 2030, registering a CAGR of 23.8% industry officials said quoting a MarketsandMarkets report.
